title: Ôn luyện Từ vựng thi vào 10 số 24: Shopping (Set 3)

lessons.title: nhúng từ
lessons.contentHtml:
Hãy cùng học các từ vựng thuộc chủ điểm Shopping (Set 3) ngay nhé!

Nhấn ᐸ / ᐳ để chuyển sang từ khác và 🔊 để nghe phát âm.

Bạn nên đọc kĩ nghĩa, ví dụ và nghe phát âm của tất cả các từ vựng trước khi nhấn "Next" để chuyển sang luyện tập ở mức nhận biết.

Read the following passage and choose the option that best fits each blank. Shopping is much easier now with the rise of 16.1 cheap offline online crowded shops, where people can order almost anything from their homes. Good customer 16.2 service behavior loyalty data , such as fast delivery and clear return policies, makes online shopping very popular. For unique products, a 16.3 convenient store speciality shop supermarket discount shop is a perfect place to explore. These shops focus on specific goods, like handmade jewelry or rare books, which attract customers looking for something special. Their 16.4 popularity responsibility stress atmosphere  has grown because they often sell items of excellent quality and unique designs. While shopping can be enjoyable, it’s important to manage spending wisely. Some people become 16.5 experts athletes inventors shopaholics who buy too much and therefore have to deal with financial problems. Buyers should prepare a shopping 16.6 system program list bill before visiting stores or shopping online to avoid overspending. Whether shopping online or in physical stores, being organized and choosing carefully can make the experience more enjoyable and efficient.
